title: Charged twice: supervisor callback in 1 business day
opening: I think I got charged twice. There are two $239 charges on my card from you guys.
callerBrief: You are Derek Martinez, phone 512-317-9695, at 895 Lakeshore Blvd, Hutto. You paid invoice INV-202442 ($239) and your card statement shows two $239 charges from Meridian, both posted, not pending. Give your name and phone when asked. You want it fixed and you do not accept that one is only a hold. Accept a supervisor callback. If asked when to call back, say afternoons. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: The dispute is passed to a supervisor, who calls back within 1 business day
